class.name: DualSenseManager
class.brief_description: Interface for controlling DualSense (PS5 controller) lightbar, rumble, and adaptive triggers.
class.description: Provides static access to DualSense features including LED control, vibration motors, and adaptive trigger effects.

method.name: set_lightbar
method.description: Sets the controller lightbar color. [color=#4FC1FF]color[/color]: RGB color applied to the lightbar.

method.name: set_player_leds
method.description: Controls the player indicator LEDs. [color=#4FC1FF]led_mask[/color]: active LED bitmask. [color=#4FC1FF]brightness[/color]: LED brightness level.

method.name: set_rumble
method.description: Sets vibration intensity for both motors. [color=#4FC1FF]left_rumble[/color]: low-frequency motor intensity. [color=#4FC1FF]right_rumble[/color]: high-frequency motor intensity.

method.name: set_rumble_for
method.description: Triggers a timed vibration effect. [color=#4FC1FF]left_rumble[/color]: low-frequency motor intensity. [color=#4FC1FF]right_rumble[/color]: high-frequency motor intensity. [color=#4FC1FF]duration_ms[/color]: duration in milliseconds.

method.name: set_trigger_bow
method.description: Applies bow-style trigger resistance. [color=#4FC1FF]start_zone[/color]: resistance start point. [color=#4FC1FF]snap_back[/color]: return behavior. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: set_trigger_custom
method.description: Applies a custom trigger effect from raw data. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger. [color=#4FC1FF]hex_bytes[/color]: encoded effect data.

method.name: set_trigger_galloping
method.description: Simulates rhythmic trigger pulses. [color=#4FC1FF]start_position[/color]: effect start zone. [color=#4FC1FF]end_position[/color]: effect end zone. [color=#4FC1FF]first_foot[/color]: first pulse strength. [color=#4FC1FF]second_foot[/color]: second pulse strength. [color=#4FC1FF]frequency[/color]: pulse speed. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: set_trigger_gamecube
method.description: Applies GameCube-style analog resistance. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: set_trigger_machine
method.description: Advanced procedural trigger effect. [color=#4FC1FF]start_zone[/color]: activation zone. [color=#4FC1FF]behavior_flag[/color]: effect mode. [color=#4FC1FF]force[/color]: force mask. [color=#4FC1FF]amplitude[/color]: strength. [color=#4FC1FF]period[/color]: cycle duration. [color=#4FC1FF]frequency[/color]: oscillation rate. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: set_trigger_machine_gun
method.description: Rapid-fire trigger pulse effect. [color=#4FC1FF]start_zone[/color]: start zone. [color=#4FC1FF]behavior[/color]: effect mode. [color=#4FC1FF]amplitude[/color]: pulse strength. [color=#4FC1FF]frequency[/color]: pulse rate. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: set_trigger_resistance
method.description: Sets constant trigger resistance. [color=#4FC1FF]start_zone[/color]: resistance start. [color=#4FC1FF]strength[/color]: resistance level. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: set_trigger_stop
method.description: Stops active trigger effects. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: set_trigger_weapon
method.description: Weapon-style trigger feedback. [color=#4FC1FF]start_zone[/color]: resistance start zone. [color=#4FC1FF]amplitude[/color]: feedback strength. [color=#4FC1FF]behavior[/color]: effect mode. [color=#4FC1FF]trigger[/color]: force profile. [color=#4FC1FF]hand[/color]: target trigger.

method.name: test_weapon
method.description: Runs a weapon trigger test sequence.

signal.name: device_connected
signal.description: Emitted when a DualSense controller connects. [color=#4FC1FF]gamepad_id[/color]: controller ID.

signal.name: device_disconnected
signal.description: Emitted when a DualSense controller disconnects. [color=#4FC1FF]gamepad_id[/color]: controller ID.
